description: A Switch node sends a0 to output 1, a1 to output 2 and a2 and a3 to the extra output, and all three outputs go to one No Operation node. v1 runs that node three times: first with a2 and a3, then with a1, then with a0. Three readers after it read the split node A in both Code modes and in an expression. $('A').item gives the item with the same id every time.
